info.name: Danial - Admin API (Sprint 1)
info.description: Section 6.6. Needs seed data. Cleans up after itself where it can (test users go back to Student, test organisation and venue are deactivated).

exec: pm.test("Token saved", () => { const t = pm.response.json().token; pm.expect(t).to.be.a("string"); pm.environment.set("studentToken", t); });
pm.test("Token saved", () => { const t = pm.response.json().token; pm.expect(t).to.be.a("string"); pm.environment.set("adminToken", t); });

const o = pm.response.json().find(x => x.name === "Data Science Society"); pm.test("Data Science Society exists (run the seed script)", () => pm.expect(o).to.exist); pm.environment.set("dssId", o.id);
const o = pm.response.json().find(x => x.name === "SMCS"); pm.test("SMCS exists", () => pm.expect(o).to.exist); pm.environment.set("smcsId", o.id);
const o = pm.response.json().find(x => x.name === "SBS"); pm.test("SBS exists", () => pm.expect(o).to.exist); pm.environment.set("sbsId", o.id);
const v = pm.response.json().find(x => x.name === "Auditorium 1"); pm.test("Auditorium 1 exists", () => pm.expect(v).to.exist); pm.environment.set("venueId", v.id);

const b = pm.response.json(); pm.test("Contract shape, no secrets", () => { b.forEach(u => { ["id", "fullName", "email", "roles", "affiliations", "isActive"].forEach(k => pm.expect(u).to.have.property(k)); pm.expect(u).to.not.have.property("passwordHash"); }); });
const me = b.find(u => u.email === "admin.test@iba.edu.pk"); pm.environment.set("adminId", me.id);

item.name: Search by email and find student2

exec: const b = pm.response.json(); pm.test("Exactly student2", () => { pm.expect(b.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(b[0].email).to.eql("student2.test@iba.edu.pk"); }); pm.environment.set("student2Id", b[0].id);

item.name: Make student2 an organiser of Data Science Society

exec: const u = pm.response.json(); pm.test("Has organiser role and the link", () => { pm.expect(u.roles).to.eql(["student", "organiser"]); pm.expect(u.affiliations[0]).to.include({ organisationName: "Data Science Society", category: "society", type: "organiser" }); });

item.name: Organiser role without a link is refused
Unknown organisation in a link is refused
Remove all links: role goes away, student stays

exec: pm.test("Back to student only", () => { const u = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(u.roles).to.eql(["student"]); pm.expect(u.affiliations).to.eql([]); });

item.name: Status must be a real boolean
Admin cannot remove own admin role

exec: const o = pm.response.json(); pm.test("Created, active, one approver", () => { pm.expect(o.isActive).to.eql(true); pm.expect(o.approverCount).to.eql(1); }); pm.environment.set("newOrgId", o.id);

item.name: It appears in the student category list
Duplicate name in the same category

exec: pm.test("Each has counts and isActive", () => pm.response.json().forEach(o => { pm.expect(o.approverCount).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(o.organiserCount).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(o.isActive).to.be.a("boolean"); }));

item.name: Inactive organisation is hidden from the student list
Deactivating an organisation with pending events is blocked

exec: pm.test("Either blocked (409) or it had no pending events (200)", () => pm.expect([200, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code));
if (pm.response.code === 200) { console.warn("DSS had no pending events and is now inactive: re-activating it in the next request."); }

item.name: Make sure DSS is active again

exec: const v = pm.response.json(); pm.test("Active with capacity 80", () => { pm.expect(v.isActive).to.eql(true); pm.expect(v.capacity).to.eql(80); }); pm.environment.set("newVenueId", v.id);

item.name: Capacity must be a whole number of at least 1 (0)

exec: pm.test("Updated", () => { const v = pm.response.json(); pm.expect([v.location, v.capacity]).to.eql(["Block Q", 90]); });

item.name: New venue is offered in the event form list
Inactive venue is no longer offered
Admin list still shows the inactive venue

exec: pm.test("Listed as inactive", () => { const v = pm.response.json().find(x => x.id === pm.environment.get("newVenueId")); pm.expect(v.isActive).to.eql(false); });
pm.test("Every event has a history array", () => pm.response.json().forEach(e => pm.expect(e.history).to.be.an("array")));

item.name: There is no way to edit an event as admin (PUT)
There is no way to delete an event as admin

exec: const s = pm.response.json(); pm.test("Has domains and three type lists", () => { pm.expect(s.allowedEmailDomains).to.be.an("array"); ["society", "school", "department"].forEach(c => pm.expect(s.eventTypes[c]).to.be.an("array")); });
